texts.t: Can Siena work across multiple channels?

Absolutely. Siena works across email, SMS, chat, WhatsApp, social media (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok), voice, and more—all from a unified AI that maintains context across channels. Your customers get the same experience whether they reach out on Instagram or email.
Does Siena handle pre-purchase and post-purchase interactions?
Yes. Siena's Shopping Agent handles product discovery, recommendations, and conversions, while the Customer Service Agent manages post-purchase support like returns, exchanges, and tracking.
Why does Siena include implementation support instead of self-service setup?

Because high-quality automation requires expertise most brands don't have yet. Our implementation team manages setup from day one: connecting systems, structuring your knowledge base, and configuring automations that mirror your business. We apply proven frameworks from hundreds of implementations t
What's the difference between Siena's pricing and Gorgias's pricing model?

Siena uses transparent per-conversation pricing. You know exactly what you're paying for—no hidden formulas, no debates over what counts as "resolved." Gorgias uses outcome-based pricing, which sounds appealing but creates disputes over resolution definitions and unpredictable costs. With Siena, cos
Does Siena require me to use a specific helpdesk?

No. Siena sits on top of your existing helpdesk—whether that's Zendesk, Kustomer, Gorgias, Dixa, or others. You can switch helpdesks anytime without losing Siena. Gorgias AI only works with the Gorgias helpdesk, locking you into their ecosystem. If you ever want to change your helpdesk, you lose you
What if I want to switch from Gorgias to another helpdesk in the future?

With Siena, switching is seamless. Siena integrates with major helpdesks like Zendesk, Kustomer, Dixa, Gladly, and Intercom, so you can move platforms while keeping all your AI automations, workflows, and training intact. Gorgias AI is dependent on the Gorgias helpdesk. If you leave Gorgias, you sta
Why do brands choose Siena over Gorgias AI?

Brands choose Siena because it's built AI-native from the ground up, not bolted onto an existing helpdesk. Siena delivers 80% automation rates that remain stable and improve over time. Siena works on top of your existing helpdesk (Zendesk, Kustomer, Gorgias, etc.), so you're never locked in. If you
Is Siena suitable for enterprise brands?

Yes. Siena is trusted by enterprise brands and is SOC 2, GDPR, CPRA, and HIPAA compliant. Our reasoning architecture provides the visibility, control, and explainability enterprise teams need. We offer dedicated onboarding, Slack support, and custom integrations for complex tech stacks.
